summary: A promise can sound generous until the budget, policy, or deadline reveals who will actually be left without what was promised.
body: A promise can sound generous until the budget, policy, or deadline reveals who will actually be left without what was promised. When Saturn opposes Neptune, ideals and practical limits face each other directly, exposing the distance between what people want to provide and what the structure is actually prepared to support. Good intentions matter, but they do not pay the bill, extend the deadline, or make an inaccessible system suddenly usable. Judge the promise by what reaches the people it was supposed to help.
